_comment: Antigravity CLI (agy) as MEASURED for the antigravity harness (lane antigravity-harness, 2026-10-20). provenance 'binary' = the real agy run OFFLINE (bwrap --unshare-net, a scratch HOME, no D-Bus session bus, strace) with no sign-in and no prompt reaching anyone; provenance 'docs' = https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/headless/ (fetched, text kept in the lane log) until a signed-in capture replaces it; provenance 'changelog' = the release notes the binary itself prints (`agy changelog`).

install.script: https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh (read, not run: it would also run `agy install`)
install.package: cli_linux_x64.tar.gz → antigravity (a 222 MB stripped Go ELF), sha512 verified
install.selfUpdate: the CLI updates itself in the background during regular runs (installer notice) — record `agy --version` per spawn

flags.--add-dir: Add a directory to the workspace (repeatable) (default [])
flags.--agent: Agent for the current CLI session
flags.--conversation: Resume a previous conversation by ID
flags.--dangerously-skip-permissions: Auto-approve all tool permission requests without prompting
flags.--disable-slash-commands: Disable slash command and skill expansion in print mode
flags.--effort: Reasoning effort for the current CLI session (low|medium|high|xhigh|max)
flags.--input-format: Input format for print mode (text, stream-json). stream-json reads one NDJSON message per line from stdin and runs a turn for each; it requires --output-format stream-json (default text)
flags.--json-schema: Optional JSON schema string or path to a schema file to enforce structured output (for stream-json, only applicable to the final result)
flags.--mode: Set the agent execution mode for this session (accept-edits, auto, plan)
flags.--model: Model for the current CLI session
flags.--new-project: Create a new project for this session
flags.--output-format: Output format for print mode (text, json, stream-json) (default text)
flags.--print: Run a single prompt non-interactively and print the response
flags.--print-timeout: Optional time limit for print mode; 0 waits until the turn completes (default 0s)
flags.--project: Project ID or project name for the current CLI session
flags.--prompt-interactive: Run an initial prompt interactively and continue the session
flags.--remote-control: Create a remote connection for the CLI session on start up
flags.--sandbox: Run in a sandbox with terminal restrictions enabled

flagsVsDocs.mode: binary: --mode accept-edits|auto|plan (not in the headless docs)
flagsVsDocs.printTimeout: binary: default 0s = wait until the turn completes (docs page: 5m; the changelog: changed to unlimited)

stderr: Authentication required. Please visit the URL to log in:
Or, paste the authorization code here and press Enter:
error: authentication failed or timed out
unauthenticated.behaviour: with stdin a CHARACTER DEVICE (/dev/null, /dev/zero — measured for -p and for the stream mode) it prints the OAuth URL (accounts.google.com, redirect https://antigravity.google/oauth-callback, scopes cloud-platform/userinfo/cclog/experimentsandconfigs/aicode) and WAITS up to 60 s reading a pasted authorization code on STDIN, then answers result status ERROR 'authentication failed or timed out'; with stdin a PIPE it refuses at once (streamPipe)
unauthenticated.models: agy models (offline, no login): exit 1, stderr 'Please sign in to view available models. Launch the CLI without arguments to sign in.'

streamPipe.stdin: a pipe (how the wrapper runs it)
stderr: Error: authentication required. Run 'agy' to log in, then retry.
error: authentication failed or timed out
streamPipe.behaviour: refuses AT ONCE (no URL, no wait) — the docs' 'exits with an authentication required error instead of hanging' holds for a PIPE; with stdin a character device (/dev/null, /dev/zero) it prints the URL and waits 60 s for a pasted code (the `stderr` above)

dials.offline: --version/--help: no inet connect (nscd only); models / agents / -p: DNS lookups to the resolver (127.0.0.53:53), all refused in the sandbox

files.home: everything under $HOME (XDG_CONFIG_HOME is NOT honoured: measured)
files.appData: ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/ (installation_id, conversation_summaries.db sqlite, cache/projects, log/cli-<ts>.log, builtin/skills, settings.json)
files.keyring: zalando/go-keyring; with NO D-Bus session bus the CLI bypasses the keyring and keeps the login in a file under HOME (changelog + the binary's shouldBypassKeyring)

input.requires: --output-format stream-json; a prompt on -p is dropped

inputErrors.input: a slash command the CLI handles (/model, /usage)
inputErrors.result: ERROR '/model is answered by the CLI itself and is unavailable with --input-format stream-json; run it as its own --print /model invocation'

stream.softDeny: a tool needing approval is soft-denied: the run continues, exits 0, a stderr notice names the tool and how to allow it (permissions.allow in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json, or --dangerously-skip-permissions)
stream.agyError: a turn ending on an agent / model API failure prints `AGY_ERROR: {...}` (short_error, status, code, retryability) on stderr (changelog: exit 3 for -p)

slashInPrint.words: -p "/usage" … emit one tab-separated record per line — or a structured payload under --output-format json and stream-json — without starting an agent turn, spending quota, or leaving a conversation behind

models.unknown: headless --model with an unknown slug exits 1 with an ERROR envelope (no fallback)

usage.claim: agy's release notes (the binary's own `agy changelog`): `-p "/usage"`, `/quota`, `/credits`, `/model`, `/effort`, `/skills` emit one tab-separated record per line — or a structured payload under --output-format json and stream-json — "without starting an agent turn, spending quota, or leaving a conversation behind"
usage.docs: the /usage page (antigravity.google/docs/cli/commands/usage/) describes the TUI panel only: per-model usage limits and remaining requests/tokens, refreshed from the backend when opened — no print-mode schema
usage.binary: RPC names RetrieveUserQuota / FetchQuotaStatus and quota_info / remaining_fraction / reset_time tags — not the print format (Go string tables are deduplicated: no struct can be read off them)
usage.shape: UNKNOWN until a signed-in capture — scripts/agy-usage-capture.mjs writes scripts/fixtures/antigravity-usage-<version>.json
usage.unauthenticated: measured: the json envelope ERROR "authentication failed or timed out", num_turns 0, every usage counter 0 (unauthenticated.usageStdout)
